D.t: Bobby Pulido leads by 6.2 in the forecast and wins 87% of simulations. The cushion is about 16,594 votes; a one point swing is about 1,330 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between R +1.0 and D +13.3. A normal polling error decides it.
$1.2M cash against $803K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
